description: Your Marker balance and history, and the prices. Markers are minted at 25% of every paid subscription invoice (from Stripe records) and spent on room hours beyond your tier cap (10/hour), memory blocks (250 for 25 MB, 30 days) and Letters of Introduction (1099). Never cash, never refunded, never transferred, never leave the house. Members only.
